title: Man charged with motor vehicle homicide, OUI in North Reading crash that killed 2, including minor
author: Darin Zullo

Matthew Sweeney, 21, is charged with felony motor vehicle homicide, operating under the influence, and operating to endanger, the Middlesex District Attorney’s Office said in a press release.

title: BPH issues toxic algae warning for part of Charles River
author: Madison Lucchesi
bullets: Local News Residents should avoid contact with water in the Charles River Lower Basin until further notice.
Boston Public Health Commission The Boston Public Health Commission issued a toxic algae warning for part of the Charles River on Thursday.
The Charles River Lower Basin downstream of the Massachusetts Avenue Bridge is impacted by a cyanobacteria, or blue-green, algae, bloom, the commission said.
